title: Engineering All-Hands — Feb 26 2026
content:
Attendees: eng org (all teams) — Maya Chen (host), Ethan Lewis, Priya Raman, Liam O'Connor, Sara Nguyen, leads and ICs from Serving Runtime, Platform, SRE, Console, Private Deployments.

Purpose: Quick org-wide update, surface major wins/risks, sync on priorities and upcoming milestones. Notes are intentionally lightweight — see linked slides for metrics dashboards.

1) High-level KPIs and business context
- Traffic & usage: Hosted API q/q growth ~23% in Feb; peak token/sec up 17% week-over-week. Dedicated committed capacity increased by 12 customers this quarter (notable traction).
- Cost per 1M tokens (platform avg): slight uptick due to higher long-sequence jobs from one major customer; Optimize team working on targeted batch/profile changes.
- Reliability: platform-wide SLOs met at 99.95% for Feb. One incident in week of Feb 9 (see incident summary below) impacted a small % of Dedicated tenants for ~28m.

2) Product & engineering highlights (last 2 weeks)
- Serving Runtime
  - rolled out KV cache LRU improvements to reduce memory churn on long conversations (PRs merged: runtime#812, runtime#821). Early internal benchmarks show 8–12% CPU reduction for 32k-context workloads.
- Model catalog: added two quantized Llama variants for private customers (QA in progress).
- Platform/Orchestration
  - Smart routing beta extended to 20 customers; default fallback policy now supports model-variant mapping per route. Need more integration tests around cross-region fallback.
- Autoscaling: improved prediction smoothing to reduce thrash on bursty workloads.
- Console & Observability
  - New per-route token-cost breakout is in beta; rolling to prod next week. Console team collecting feedback from PGs (product groups).

3) Incidents & postmortems
- Feb 9 incident (INC-2026-02-09-01) — summary: autoscaler misinterpreted transient telemetry leading to an over-provision decision that exhausted a single zone's capacity and triggered throttling for ~45 Dedicated instances. Root cause: edge-case in prediction smoothing + missing guardrail for zone affinity.
- Mitigations implemented: temporary guardrail added to autoscaler (hotfix deployed Feb 10), capacity rebalancer tuned to avoid single-zone saturation, postmortem writeup published (link above). Action items: add unit/integration tests for zone-affinity case (owner: Priya, due Mar 15), schedule tabletop for cross-region failover (owner: Liam, due Mar 8).

4) Roadmap & near-term priorities (next 6 weeks)
- Finish rollout of per-route cost telemetry and surface actionable suggestions in Optimize (owner: Ethan).
- Private deployments: finalize 0.9.1 on-prem package (security audit almost done) — target GA candidate Mar 18.
- Serving runtime: finish quantization path for 4-bit kernels (blocked on a vendor patch — vendor ETA Mar 9).
- Reliability: expand canary coverage for autoscaler changes; require observational gating in staging for all autoscaler releases.

5) Hiring & org updates
- New hires: welcome Priya Raman (Senior PM, Platform) and Sara Nguyen (SRE manager).
- Team capacity: Platform has two backend hires approved; recruiting active.

6) Requests from leadership / ask-back
- Product teams: please sign off on the per-route pricing UX by Mar 5 (design review tickets linked in slides).
- Solutions/SE: we need 3 example enterprise traffic traces to validate fallback policies against real patterns — upload anonymized traces to the shared S3 bucket or ping Ethan for secure upload.

7) Open Q&A highlights
- Q: Any timeline for more granular embargoed logs for Private customers? A: Security/compliance working on KMS-backed log routing; ETA end of Q2.
- Q: Will we expand Dedicated regions? A: Sales and infra discussing north-america/EMEA expansion; committed plan dependent on a few anchor customers.

8) Decisions made
- Canaries for autoscaler changes are now mandatory and must run for 48h with predefined traffic profiles before roll.
- Per-route token-cost telemetry goes to GA on Mar 10 if no critical issues from beta.

9) Action items (owner / due):
- Priya — add tests for zone-affinity autoscaler case / Mar 15
- Liam — schedule tabletop for cross-region failover / Mar 8
- Ethan — collect enterprise traffic traces from SEs / Mar 5
- Maya — follow up with vendor for 4-bit kernel patch; escalate if not delivered by Mar 9

Notes-to-self / rough items (raw brainstorms that came up in Q&A):
- Consider a small internal deck + checklist for customers to reduce long-sequence costs (best practices + prompt design).
- Investigate offering a managed prefix-cache product for high-value LLM apps (early sketch).

References & artifacts: see linked Confluence page and slides. Postmortem and incident docs are in the SRE folder (INC-2026-02-09-01).

End of notes.
